source: segmentation (internet footage, background replaced by white)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1280x720 frame) and seconds

camera.motion: cannot be measured directly (background removed, no static reference visible). Indirect: player's feet stay at y 585-593 and x ~372-445 all clip, consistent with a static or nearly static camera. Treat as static.

ball.description: basketball, brown/orange, ~17 px diameter; the only ball. Dribbled once, held, then shot in a jump shot in an arc to the right toward an (invisible, segmented-out) hoop near x~800, y~380

player.reference_point: mask centroid (cx, cy); feet_y = lowest mask pixel
